--Methodology notes: This sheet is an "Engagement Touchmap" variant of renewal pipeline trackers. Columns combine quantitative signals (ARR, Health Score, usage trends) with micro-cadence actions.

--Health Score calculation guidance: Start at 50 baseline; +10 for active weekly usage, +15 for executive sponsorship, +12 for >20% QoQ usage growth, -20 for severity-level incidents in last 30 days, -10 for billing disputes.

--Probability adjustments: Base probability derived from health score mapped to bands (Health 80+ => 85% probability, 65-79 => 70%, 50-64 => 50%, <50 => 30%). Adjust +/- 10% for contract complexity and discounts.

--Playbook quick references: executive-brief (C-level renewal briefing template + SOW addendum), usage-driven (adoption plan + ROI dashboard), discount-accelerator (time-limited pricing), adoption-kickstart (feature workshops and success sprints), escalation-play (SRE + legal triage), enterprise-bundle (multi-product pricing + Dedicated trial).

--Action cadence recommendations (micro-cadence): weekly touch for high-risk (<50 health), biweekly for mid-risk (50-74), monthly for low-risk (75+). Add legal and finance check-ins 45 days prior to contract end.

--Next steps legend: owner initials followed by action; maintain one-line summary in Notes.

--Revision log: 2027-02-15 initial draft by Aisha Patel; 2027-03-22 added playbook glossary; 2027-05-10 updated probabilities after usage import (Jillian Wu).
